headline: Building use requests for lacrosse practice, indoor soccer clinics, and Whitney Players auditions, rehearsals, and performances at Hamden schools.
summary: Five requests would let outside groups use school space. Hamden Youth Lacrosse, the Hamden Soccer Association, and the Whitney Players ask for fields, a gym, and theater rooms.
items: Hamden Youth Lacrosse use of school fields for practice, March 21, 2027-June 20, 2027
Hamden Soccer Association indoor soccer clinics in the Ridge Hill School gym, January 8, 2027-February 26, 2027
Whitney Players spring musical auditions at Hamden Middle School, December 16, 2026
Whitney Players rehearsals at Hamden Middle School, March 2027
Whitney Players performances at Hamden Middle School, March 2027

ANNOUNCEMENT OF ZOOM OPERATIONS COMMITTEE 
MEETING AGENDA 
 When: December 1, 2026 7:00 PM  
 Location- Zoom 
 
To join the meeting virtually, please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/85173224683?pwd=Qb3CALzC7Qmlp6kAuBxtddpdnzY060.1  
Passcode:135266 
 
Telephone: +1 646 931 3860, +1 301 715 8592, +1 305 224 1968, +1 309 205 3325, +1 312 626 6799 
Webinar ID: 851 7322 4683 
Passcode: 135266 
 
Note: Any member of the public may request, in writing, a physical location and “any electronic equipment necessary” to attend the 
meeting in real-time. Said request shall be made to tdonnarummo@hamden.org not less than twenty-four (24) hours prior to the 
meeting. 
For those who wish to make Public Comments: Time will be allotted for public comments at the beginning of 
the meeting. We ask that public comments be limited to no more than 1 minute in length. You may also submit 
your comment in writing. Public comments should be sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, with the message's 
subject stating the meeting's name and date (for example, “May 12 Operations Committee Meeting”). Public 
comments will be accepted up to 1pm the day of the meeting. Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the 
message. 
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 
characters). 
• Comments should start with a 2-3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire 
message if there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety would 
extend beyond the time allotted for public comment. 
 
1. Call to order and roll call 
 
2. Public Comments on Agenda Items 
 
3. Additions to the Agenda 
 
4. Action Items 
a. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Youth Lacrosse to use the Upper Turf Baseball Field 
at Hamden High School from March 21, 2027-June 20, 2027 Sundays from 9-10am, the Main 
Turf Field March 21, 2027-June 20, 2027 Sundays from 8am-3pm and West Woods School March 
21, 2027-June 20, 2027 Monday-Friday from 5pm-8pm for Lacrosse practice 
b. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Soccer Association to use the gymnasium at Ridge 
Hill School Fridays January 8, 2027-February 26, 2027 from 5:30pm-7:30pm for indoor soccer 
clinics 
c. Approval of the building use by the Whitney Players to use the Auditorium, classroom, cafeteria 
and the music/band room at Hamden Middle School on December 16, 2026 from 5:30pm-9pm 
for spring musical auditions 
d. Approval of the building use by the Whitney Players to use the Auditorium, classroom, cafeteria 
and the music/band room at Hamden Middle School March 1,3,5, 8, 9, 2027 from 5:30pm-9pm 
for rehearsal 
e. Approval of the building use by the Whitney Players to use the Auditorium, classroom, cafeteria 
and the music/band room at Hamden Middle School March 10,11, 122027 from 5:30pm-9pm 
and March 13, 2027 from 12-7pm for performance 
 
5. Adjournment
